text:
dara: dropping a quick design probe for the compare table: idea is a single-line density with an always-present compact affordance that becomes explicit on keyboard focus. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/compare-compact-affordance
\nmicah: I like keeping it compact. Concern: a visual-only affordance will be invisible to keyboard/sr users. We need a focusable control and clear aria props.
\nanya: Agree. Proposal: render a 12px chevron visually, but make the actual focus target 44px and visually collapse to the chevron. When focused, show a small tooltip 'View metrics (Enter)'.
\nrowan: Perf note: avoid rendering full metric components for every row. Render a lightweight badge + lazy-load details when the inspector is opened. Also ensure reveal uses transform/opacity to avoid layout shifts.
\nkevin: Pinning question: if user pins a version from the compact view, do we surface a persistent pin icon in explorer? I'd prefer a subtle inline label 'Pinned' and an optional 'Set team default' in the pin menu.
\ndara: Yeah, I'll spec per-user pinned state by default with a 'Make team default' secondary action requiring admin perms. Also will add an undo toast: 'Pinned version 2.3. Undo'.
\nanya: Accessibility: use aria-controls to point from the affordance to the inspector region, and aria-expanded to reflect open/closed. For screen readers include a sr-only helper: 'Press Enter to open metrics panel for version X'.
\na11y-bot: Reminder checklist: 44px focus target, visible focus ring, contrast >=4.5:1 for small badge text, reduced-motion support, aria-live for pin/unpin confirmations. See intranet: /a11y/compare-checklist
\nmicah: Microcopy nits: prefer the verb 'View' over 'Open' or 'Show' for the affordance. So tooltip: 'View metrics 83 Enter' (or 'View metrics  Enter' but keep it short). SR string can be longer.
\nrowan: For the badge stack order: latency then accuracy then cost by default. But let users reorder in settings. Small cog next to the badges that opens a reorder popover with drag handles + up/down keyboard controls.
\nkevin: Also think about announcing badge updates dynamically. If we surface live perf changes, use aria-live=\"polite\" and avoid focus theft.
\nanya: CSS stub for reveal and hit area:
```css
.affordance { width:44px; height:44px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; }
.chev { width:12px; height:12px; }
.badge { transform: translateY(4px); opacity:0; transition: transform .12s ease, opacity .12s ease; }
.row:focus-within .badge, .row:hover .badge { transform: translateY(0); opacity:1; }
```
\ndara: Good call on virtualization. For catalogs >250 rows we should virtualize and ensure keyboard moves rows into view smoothly. Add guidance: when inspector opens, keep focus inside the panel and restore to the affordance on close.
\nmicah: QA item: include the exact aria strings and contrast tokens in the PR so automated checks can run. Also include a small script to simulate keyboard-only flow for the e2e suite.
\na11y-bot: Accessibility walkthrough scheduled 2026-04-02 11:00 PT. Please attach staging preview and PR link.
\ndara: Action items: 1) update figma with 44px focus target + sr copy 2) add pin UX with undo toast + 'Make team default' action 3) add badge reorder cog + keyboard controls 4) include aria strings & contrast screenshots in PR 5) ensure reduced-motion + virtualization notes. Will upload preview later today and ping back here. Thanks! :seedling:
